topic: K-Stick and the Mirror That Copies Him Late
hook_text: Why is K-Stick's reflection always one move behind?

scenes.story_text: K-Stick walks up to the mirror, adjusts his red cap, and smiles proudly.
He waves, but the reflection waves a moment later. K-Stick freezes, then rapidly changes poses to test it.
The reflection keeps lagging behind, making every pose look hilariously out of sync.
K-Stick walks away, but his delayed reflection finally catches up, steps out of the mirror, and takes his place. K-Stick returns, sees the new reflection, and both stare at each other in confusion.
